sql: SELECT e.key AS experiment, e.state, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.started_at, a.arm_key, a.role, da.strategy_tag, (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades pt WHERE pt.strategy = da.strategy_tag AND pt.created_at >= d.started_at) AS entries_since_armed, round(extract(epoch from (now() - d.started_at))/3600.0, 1) AS hours_armed FROM experiments e JOIN experiment_versions v ON v.experiment_id = e.id JOIN experiment_epochs ep ON ep.version_id = v.id AND ep.ended_at IS NULL JOIN experiment_deployments d ON d.epoch_id = ep.id AND d.ended_at IS NULL JOIN experiment_deployment_arms da ON da.deployment_id = d.id JOIN experiment_arms a ON a.id = da.arm_id WHERE e.state IN ('PAPER','LIVE_CANARY','PRODUCTION') ORDER BY e.key, d.deployment_key, a.arm_key
purpose: false-positive check for the armed-but-silent detector across all active deployment arms
